subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the runtime legacy branch that treats no-pluginId, no-code diagnostics with a missing absolute source as stale, or should that upgrade cleanup move to doctor/migration before merge?
rationale: Repository policy treats persisted state and runtime compatibility paths as upgrade-sensitive, and the PR intentionally changes how upgraded SQLite diagnostics are trusted during startup.

options.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
options.body: Land the PR with the runtime legacy branch once visible latest-head proof shows a pre-code SQLite row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Remove the runtime no-code branch and handle old diagnostics through a doctor or migration-owned repair path instead.

options.title: Accept Source And Tests Only
options.body: Maintainers can waive the external proof gap and accept source/test evidence, but that owns the upgrade risk without contributor real-behavior output.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the runtime legacy branch once visible latest-head proof shows a pre-code SQLite row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and has recent history on the affected plugin-registry files.
